lab.title: Claude Code and Codex CLI, 10 tasks x 10 runs
notes: Claude Code was pinned with --model claude-opus-5-5. With no model flag, Claude Code on this account reported claude-opus-4-8 on 2026-10-06 (it reported claude-opus-5-5 on 2026-10-03, also with the same CLI version 2.1.288), so the pinned set is the one compared here. The 100 default-model runs (100 of 100 passed) are in the source directory.
Codex CLI ran 2026-10-06 17:43 to 19:02 UTC; Claude Code (pinned) ran 2026-10-07 01:26 to 01:49 UTC.
One Codex run (write-tests run 3) hung after the Mac went to sleep mid-run and was replaced with a fresh run of the same task and index; the original record is kept in the source directory.
All 4 failures were Codex CLI runs that read the task files, changed nothing and exited 0 after 7 to 10 seconds. In 3 of them the final message said the change had been made.
Claude Code reports cost as total_cost_usd at list prices. On a subscription login this is quota used, not money billed. Codex CLI reports tokens only, so its cost is not reported.
